name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
aka: 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D, Vitamin D Total, Calcidiol
about: Measures the main form of vitamin D circulating in your blood. Low levels are common and linked to fatigue, bone pain, hair fall and low immunity.

name: Vitamin B12
about: Checks your vitamin B12 level, needed for healthy nerves and red blood cells. Low B12 can cause tiredness, tingling, poor memory and anaemia.

name: Folic Acid (Vitamin B9)
aka: Folate, Vitamin B9, Serum Folic Acid
about: Measures folate, essential for making red blood cells and for a healthy pregnancy. Often tested together with B12.

name: Calcium, Serum
about: Measures calcium in your blood — important for bones, muscles, nerves and the heart.

name: Iron Studies
about: Checks how much iron you have and how well your body stores and carries it. Helps find iron-deficiency anaemia or iron overload.

name: Ferritin
about: Ferritin shows your stored iron. Low ferritin is the earliest sign of iron deficiency — a common cause of hair fall and tiredness.

name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
aka: Complete Haemogram, Full Blood Count, CBC with ESR
about: A broad screen of your red cells, white cells and platelets. Helps detect anaemia, infection, inflammation and many other conditions.

name: Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH)
aka: Thyroid Function Test, TFT, T3 T4 TSH
about: Checks how well your thyroid gland is working. Helps detect an under-active or over-active thyroid.

name: TSH (Ultrasensitive)
about: The most sensitive first test for thyroid problems, and for monitoring thyroid medication.

name: Anti-TPO Antibodies
about: Detects antibodies that attack the thyroid. Helps diagnose autoimmune thyroid conditions such as Hashimoto's.

name: HbA1c (Glycosylated Haemoglobin)
aka: Glycated Haemoglobin, A1c, Glyco Hb, Diabetes Test
about: Shows your average blood sugar over the past 2–3 months. Used to diagnose diabetes and check how well it is being controlled.

name: Glucose, Fasting
aka: Fasting Blood Sugar, FBS, Fasting Plasma Glucose
about: Measures your blood sugar after an overnight fast. A basic screen for diabetes and prediabetes.

name: Insulin, Fasting
about: Measures insulin after fasting. Helps spot insulin resistance — common with PCOS, weight gain and prediabetes.

name: Lipid Profile
about: Measures cholesterol and fats in your blood to assess your risk of heart disease and stroke.

name: hs-CRP (Inflammation)
about: Detects low-grade inflammation in the body and helps assess heart risk.

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
about: Checks how well your liver is working and looks for liver inflammation or damage.

name: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
aka: Renal Function Test, RFT, Kidney Panel
about: Checks how well your kidneys filter waste and balance salts in the blood.

name: Urine Routine & Microscopy
about: A routine check of your urine. Helps detect urinary infections, kidney problems and diabetes.

name: Testosterone, Total
about: Measures testosterone — linked to energy, mood, muscle and libido in men, and to PCOS in women.

name: Cortisol, Morning
about: Measures cortisol, your main stress hormone. Best taken in the morning.

name: PSA, Total
about: A screening test for prostate health, usually recommended for men over 50.

name: FSH (Follicle Stimulating Hormone)
about: Helps assess fertility, menstrual problems and menopause.

name: LH (Luteinizing Hormone)
about: Helps assess ovulation, fertility and PCOS. Often tested with FSH.

name: Prolactin
about: High prolactin can cause irregular periods, infertility and breast discharge.

name: Estradiol (E2)
about: Measures the main female hormone. Helps assess cycles, fertility and menopause.

name: AMH (Anti-Müllerian Hormone)
about: Estimates your ovarian (egg) reserve. Useful when planning pregnancy and in PCOS.

name: DHEA-S
about: Checks adrenal hormone levels. Often tested for PCOS, acne and excess hair growth.
